title: Ollama Classification & Structured Output

implementation_summary.approach: Ollama-backed classifier as a recommendation-only layer. Pydantic-strict JSON validation; deterministic router decides accepted vs review; controller policy from prompt 06 always wins. Every decision persisted to new V4 audit table construction_model_decisions.
components: models.py — Pydantic ModelClassification, ModelRoutingConfig, ModelTaskRouting, ClassificationDecision (extra=forbid, Literal-typed labels, range validators).
loader.py — load_model_routing_config() with seed → repo override → explicit path → HB_CONSTRUCTION_MODEL_ROUTING env precedence (mirrors construction/policy/loader.py).
validator.py — parse_and_validate(): rejects empty / non-JSON / non-object / missing-field / extra-field / out-of-range output with truncated-snippet error.
client.py — OllamaChatClient.generate_json() POSTs /api/generate with format: 'json'; raises sanitized OllamaUnavailable on any network/non-200/envelope failure (no URL/host in exception).
router.py — ClassificationRouter.decide() applies in order: protected_category → review; low_confidence → review; controller-policy-flagged → review (model cannot override controller); else accepted.
service.py — ClassificationService classify_with_raw (offline) and classify_item (live) entry points; persists every decision; forces 'review' when model echoes back wrong item_id.
Seed YAML resources/config/ollama_model_routing.seed.yaml (default_model llama3.2:1b, threshold 0.7, full protected list, classification + review_reason tasks).
V4 SQLite migration adds construction_model_decisions + 2 indexes; additive, idempotent.
ConstructionStore extended with record_model_decision / list_model_decisions / count_model_decisions.
CLI sub-app construction-agent classify {run, decisions} with offline --fixture and --mock-output paths.

pytest_regression_sweep.command: python -m pytest tests/test_construction_*.py tests/test_store.py tests/test_store_links.py tests/test_config.py

pytest_broader_sweep.command: python -m pytest tests/ (excluding documented hang-prone files and the 4 pre-existing test_obsidian_writer baseline failures; -k 'not test_graph')

schema_migration.command: python -c 'from hb_assistant.store.migrator import SQLiteMigrator; m=SQLiteMigrator(); print(m.apply(), m.apply())'

cli_smoke._notes: All transcripts captured against an isolated tmp SQLite via the same monkeypatch pattern used by the test suite. Live Ollama not contacted.

decisions._note: Demonstrates layered defense — protected-category check AND controller policy both fire.

mock_invalid._note: Nothing persisted on rejection — confirmed by decisions count remaining unchanged.

ollama_is_recommendation_only.evidence: test_router_accepts_high_confidence_non_protected (positive path) plus the three review-routing tests below establish that 'accepted' is the only positive verdict and it requires non-protected label + above-threshold confidence + no controller-policy flag.

invalid_json_is_rejected.evidence: Six validator-rejection tests plus CLI mock_invalid exit-1 path. Nothing is persisted on rejection.

models_never_execute_file_operations.evidence: Classification module imports only ConstructionStore (SQLite-only) plus Pydantic/requests. No filesystem, subprocess, or vault writer is reachable from the classifier surface.

models_never_override_controller_validat.evidence: Router consults ReviewPolicyEvaluator (controller policy from prompt 06) and forces status='review' on any match, regardless of model confidence. test_router_controller_policy_overrides_model_high_confidence asserts this at confidence 1.0.

no_protected_category_auto_accept.evidence: test_router_routes_protected_category_to_review asserts even confidence 1.0 on a contract label routes to review.

no_source_document_body_text_read.evidence: Service._build_prompt reads only inventory_item['name'] and inventory_item['parent_path']. test_decision_record_never_carries_body_text seeds a contaminating body sentinel into the inventory dict and asserts it never appears in the persisted decision JSON.

no_external_writeback.evidence: Module imports never touch graph, procore, onedrive, outlook surfaces. CLI live-call path is explicitly disabled (status='live_call_disabled') — exercise requires --mock-output.

controller_policy_parity_with_prompt_06.evidence: test_protected_categories_match_review_queue_seed asserts PROTECTED_CATEGORIES in the classification module is a superset of the review-queue policy's PROTECTED_CATEGORIES — they cannot drift apart.

known_limitations: Live Ollama call is not exercised in CI — only mocked. The CLI 'live' code path is intentionally disabled (returns status='live_call_disabled'); use --mock-output to exercise the validator + router + store. Wiring an interactive live mode is intentionally deferred to a later prompt.

Full `python -m pytest` remains out of scope — the same hang-prone exclusion list documented in prompt 06 evidence still applies (test_cli_canonical non-help subset, test_auth, test_automation, test_actions_cli, test_files_cli, test_graph_*, test_mutation_lockout, test_sensitive_scan_cli, test_mvp_local_runtime_evidence).
Four pre-existing test_obsidian_writer failures (action_item_ids API drift) are baseline and unrelated to this work.
Controller policy from prompt 06 remains authoritative for the review-required vault note. Model decisions live in a separate audit table by design — the rule-based review queue is unchanged.
